skills.name: conceptExplanation
skills.trigger: User asks to teach/explain a concept (e.g. eigenvalue).
questionAxes: explanation style: simple, standard, step-by-step, comprehensive
focus: geometric intuition, definition/calculation, applications, pitfalls

skills.name: systematicLearning
skills.trigger: Deep Learn session or structured class-like learning without a concrete deadline.
questionAxes: direct plan output; no clarification axis observed

skills.name: whiteboardSession
skills.trigger: mode is board_session or user explicitly asks for a whiteboard lesson/session.

skills.name: cheatsheetGeneration
skills.trigger: User explicitly asks for a PDF cheatsheet from uploaded/in-context material.

skills.name: planTasks
skills.trigger: User asks for a future plan, especially a time-bound exam/study plan.

skills.name: documentReading
skills.trigger: User attaches a document and asks to summarize, read, or closely guide through it.
